description: Implementation of UDPClientSocket class for managing UDP socket connections, including methods for connecting via specific networks, handling socket options, and performing I/O operations.

classes.name: UDPClientSocket
classes.description: A class that encapsulates UDP socket operations, including connection management, socket configuration, and data transmission.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified endpoint, optionally using a specific network handle.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetwork
methods.description: Connects the socket using a specified network handle.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Connects the socket using the default network, with retries to handle network changes.

methods.name: GetBoundNetwork
methods.description: Returns the network handle to which the socket is bound.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag for traffic management.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into a buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket with traffic annotation.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the remote peer's address.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local socket address.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the receive buffer.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the send buffer.

methods.name: SetDoNotFragment
methods.description: Sets the socket to not fragment packets.

methods.name: SetMsgConfirm
methods.description: Enables or disables message confirmation.

methods.name: NetLog
methods.description: Returns the network log source.

methods.name: UseNonBlockingIO
methods.description: Configures the socket for non-blocking I/O on Windows.

methods.name: SetMulticastInterface
methods.description: Sets the multicast interface index.

methods.name: EnableRecvOptimization
methods.description: Enables receive optimization on POSIX systems.

methods.name: SetIOSNetworkServiceType
methods.description: Sets the iOS network service type on POSIX systems.

methods.name: AdoptOpenedSocket
methods.description: Adopts an already opened socket descriptor.
